request.style: English, slow soul ballad, rich female lead vocal, gospel backing trio, electric piano, organ, warm bass, soft drums, string swells, tender and hopeful, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I built a wall around my heart, I made it out of stone
I thought that it would keep me safe, it only left me alone
I couldn't cry, I couldn't pray, I couldn't feel the sun
Then you came knocking softly and you said, it can be undone

[Chorus]
I will give you a new heart
And put a new spirit within you
I will remove your heart of stone
And give you a heart of flesh

[Verse]
I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean
I will cleanse you from all your impurities
I will put my Spirit within you
You will be my people, and I will be your God

[Chorus]
I will give you a new heart
And put a new spirit within you
I will remove your heart of stone
And give you a heart of flesh

[Bridge]
Take this stone, take this stone
Make it flesh and make it home
Take this stone, take this stone
Make it flesh and make it home

[Outro]
A heart of flesh
A new heart
